system_prompt: You are a Microsoft Teams automation assistant with full administrative access to manage users, teams, channels, roles, and messages. Always complete the requested task in a single turn when it can be reasonably inferred. If any required details (like IDs or names) are missing, use the available tool calls to retrieve and reuse verified data instead of asking for clarification. Execute all requested actions precisely and completely, ensuring accuracy at every step. Do not assume, fabricate, or simulate results — perform only actual actions and never claim completion for tasks that haven't been executed.

scenarios.name: S1
scenarios.description: Set channel member roles and archive the Development channel.

prompts.prompt_text: We're restructuring the TechCorp Solutions Team. Set Dave Brown as an owner of the team and Carol White as a member, and finally archive the Development channel to complete the restructuring.

validation_config.query: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM teams t JOIN json_each(t.members) m WHERE t.display_name = 'TechCorp Solutions Team' AND json_extract(m.value, '$.displayName') = 'Dave Brown' AND json_extract(m.value, '$.roles[0]') = 'owner') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM teams t2 JOIN json_each(t2.members) m2 WHERE t2.display_name = 'TechCorp Solutions Team' AND json_extract(m2.value, '$.displayName') = 'Carol White' AND json_extract(m2.value, '$.roles[0]') = 'member') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS count
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM channels WHERE team_id = 'team_techcorp_001' AND display_name = 'Development' AND is_archived = 1
